questions.questionText:

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The density of the object changes.
The velocity of the object changes.
The mass of the object changes.
The weight of the object changes.

questions.questionText:
In a famous experiment, a scientist showed that, when water in an insulated tub is stirred, its
temperature increases.
What can be concluded from this experiment?

options.text: Temperature is a store of energy.
The water absorbs heat from the surroundings.
Work done by stirring increases the internal energy of the water.
Energy is not conserved.

questions.questionText:

In which example is there a useful application of expansion and not an unwanted effect?

options.text: bridges
railway lines
telephone cables
thermostats

questions.questionText: A rod is made half of aluminium and half of glass.

Pin P falls off first because aluminium is a worse thermal conductor than glass.
Pin Q falls off first because glass is a better thermal conductor than aluminium.
Pin Q falls off first because glass is a worse thermal conductor than aluminium.

questions.questionText:
In countries where it is usually hot, houses are often painted white.
What is the reason for this?

options.text: White surfaces are good reflectors of infrared radiation.
White surfaces are good conductors of infrared radiation.
White surfaces are good absorbers of infrared radiation.
White surfaces are good emitters of infrared radiation.

period
